service.lanes.targetCard: {card} merges into {cardTarget}, and this lane into {target}: a lane’s cards merge where it does. Leave it out, or start it in a lane of its own.
service.lanes.targetFixed: {builder}’s lane merges into {target} until it ends: start a new lane for another branch. Once {target} has been merged into another branch, a retarget of Work merges into moves the lane and its card there (Also retarget what can move).
service.lanes.targetMissing: {unknown, select, yes {Combwork can’t tell whether the branch {target} exists, so the lane wasn’t started.} other {There is no branch {target} in this repository: make it first, then start the lane on it.}}
service.lanes.targetNotListed: {hasTargets, select, yes {{target} isn’t a branch work can merge into here: name {default}{hasOthers, select, yes { or one of {others}} other {}}, or add it under Other branches work can merge into (Version Control → Workflow).} other {This project merges work into no branch Combwork can pick: a lane’s Merges into is for Git projects.}}
service.lanes.targetRulesOff: A lane merges into another branch only while workflow rules are enforced (Settings → Advanced).
service.lanes.teamPaused: The team is paused (before an update): resume the team first, then start the lane.
service.mcp.addedDropped: Each project and the Assistant lists the servers that ran there. {n, plural, one {# choice kept for a server that was off in the workspace was} other {# choices kept for servers that were off in the workspace were}} dropped: add a server in a project’s MCP tab where you need it.
service.mcp.addedTitle: MCP servers are now added where they run
service.metrics.badProvider: provider must be a provider id
service.metrics.badRange: from and to must be ISO times, from before to
service.metrics.badRole: role must be agent, assistant, api or viewer
service.metrics.droppedPerProject: Dropped measurements are counted per project, not per role or provider.
service.metrics.notCliContext: Context a CLI adds itself (its own system prompt, tool definitions, files it reads).
service.metrics.notNetwork: Provider network traffic: Combwork starts the CLIs; it is not a proxy between them and their providers.
service.metrics.notPerProvider: Agent API requests and tool calls aren’t recorded per provider: they are every provider’s.
service.metrics.notSkillReads: Whether a model read a skill: delivered skills are counted, reading one is not observable.
service.metrics.notTokens: Provider tokens per Combwork tool or per guidance part: providers report a session’s usage, not what each part of its context cost.
service.metrics.notTransport: HTTP headers and transport: request sizes are the body bytes received, response sizes the JSON body written (an aborted reply may not all have been sent).
service.metrics.sharedNumbers: The skill service and Combwork-wide numbers are shared: not per role or provider.
service.nameUpgrade.boardNotFolded: Combwork couldn't rename the board's file {file} to combwork.db: its log {log} still holds changes after it was closed. Close any other program using the workspace, then open it again. Nothing was lost.
service.nameUpgrade.boardOrphan: The workspace's board file is missing, but {file} beside where it was holds changes that may be the only copy of them. Combwork won't start an empty board over it. Close Combwork, put the board's file back beside it under its old name, {old} (from .combwork\backups or another copy), then open the workspace again.
service.nameUpgrade.failed: Combwork couldn't finish renaming {what} from the old names to Combwork's: {error} Open the workspace again to finish. Nothing was lost.
service.nameUpgrade.profileFailed: Combwork couldn't convert {files} from the old names to Combwork's: another program may have {n, plural, one {it} other {them}} open. Close that program and start Combwork again. Nothing was changed.
service.nextVersion.movedOn: Work merges into is {now} now, not {from}, so nothing was changed: look again.
service.nextVersion.noName: Name the next version’s branch: {from} doesn’t read as a version to propose one from.
service.nextVersion.notBranch: {from} isn’t a branch in this repository, so nothing can start from it.
service.nextVersion.notGit: Start the next version needs a project using Git.
service.nextVersion.partial: Created {name} at {commit}, but the workflow options weren’t saved: {why} {name} was kept ({kept, select, moved {it has moved since} worktree {it is checked out} inUse {it is in use} gone {it is gone} other {it couldn’t be removed}}): delete it in Version Control if it isn’t wanted.
service.nextVersion.sameName: The next version needs a branch of its own, not {from}.
service.providers.keysStopped: {task}: Combwork stopped typing into it, as {why}. Finish it in the terminal.
service.providers.pickNotFound: {task}: Combwork couldn't find {item}. Do it in the terminal, or update Combwork.
service.providers.retryUnavailable: This update retry is no longer available. Check again, then try Update.
service.providers.signInConnections: {cli} signs in per account: sign in from Settings → Accounts & Connections.
service.providers.stillLooking: Combwork is still looking for {cli}. Try again in a moment.
service.providers.stillLookingAll: Combwork is still looking for the coding agent CLIs. Try again in a moment.
service.providers.stopFirst: Stop all running {cli} agents before updating it.
service.providers.stoppedBusy: {seconds, plural, one {it stayed busy for # second} other {it stayed busy for # seconds}}
service.providers.task: {task, select, install {{cli} install} update {{cli} update} login {{cli} sign-in} other {{cli} setup}}
service.providers.unknownHost: No project uses that GitHub host for {cli} now. Check again, then sign in.
service.queue.catchUpNoCommit: {card} is merged and on {target}’s remote already: a commit here would put one on {target} that its remote doesn’t have. Set the changes aside instead, and {target} catches up.
service.queue.pauseChanged: The merge queue's pause changed meanwhile: nothing was committed or set aside. Look again.
service.queue.pauseNoFolder: Combwork doesn't know which folder these changes were in. Resume the queue: it looks again and says where.
service.repoOps.notOffered: Version control ({platform}) doesn’t offer that here.
service.slots.resumeFailed: Combwork couldn't resume {agent}'s conversation in {slot} for {card} (three tries): {why}. Resume {agent} from Sessions, or start it fresh, and Combwork gives it {card}.
service.slots.resumeHeld: Combwork can't give {card} to {agent} yet: {agent}'s conversation in {slot} can't resume now ({why}). Combwork gives it {card} once it can.
service.targetChanges.message: {folder} has {count, plural, one {an uncommitted change} other {# uncommitted changes}}: {files}. A merge into {target} that changes them pauses until they are committed or set aside.
service.targetChanges.more: {files} and {more, plural, one {# more} other {# more}}
service.targetChanges.title: Uncommitted changes where {target} is checked out
service.templates.v09: 1.0 templates don’t pin agents to worktrees, so the Combwork templates take their place. A copy of {n, plural, one {the template} other {the # templates}} is kept with the 0.9 board backup.
service.templates.v09Title: Your 0.9 agent templates aren’t used in 1.0
service.transcripts.busy: This session is being archived or deleted. Try again in a moment.
service.transcripts.imageNotKept: The image is not stored in the transcript
service.transcripts.none: This session has no transcript yet.
service.workflow.changedMeanwhile: The workflow options changed meanwhile (in another window, or by the Assistant), so nothing was saved. The section shows them as they are now.
service.workflow.closed: The workspace this card belongs to has closed
service.workflow.inheritor: Project {project} inherits these options, and the change would make its options contradict each other:
service.workflow.targetInUse: {branch} can’t be taken out of Other branches work can merge into while these use it: {uses}. Retarget or finish them first.
service.workflow.targetMissing: {n, plural, one {{branches} doesn’t exist} other {{branches} don’t exist}}, so nothing was saved: create {n, plural, one {it} other {them}} first (Version Control → New branch…).
service.workflowNotice.mergeDue: Every card passed review: its merge is due
service.workflowNotice.merging: {card} is being merged: the lane waits for it
service.workflowNotice.notMerged: {card} passed review: the lane waits for it to be merged
service.workflowNotice.safeguardGuidance: Check {provider}’s guidance on its safety filter.
service.workflowNotice.stalledSafeguard: {card} has stalled. {agent}’s latest turn was stopped by {provider}’s safety filter at {time} ({stops, plural, one {# stop} other {# stops}} this session): look at its pane.
service.workspace.advancedNotHere: {setting} can't be set for a workspace.
service.workspace.badName: Project names cannot start with "." or contain {chars}
service.workspace.connectionGone: The connection chosen for {agent} was removed, or is being removed. Choose another.
service.workspace.holdsOpen: The workspace {workspace}, open in another window, is inside {folder}. Close it first to open {name} as a workspace.
service.workspace.insideOpen: {folder} is inside the workspace {workspace}, which is open in another window. Close that workspace first, or open this folder's projects from there.
service.workspace.notProject: Not a project in the open workspace: {path}
service.workspace.notRoot: Not a project or agent worktree in the open workspace: {path}
service.workspace.openElsewhere: {folder} is already open in another window.
service.workspace.platformGitFound: {project} is a Git repository now. Combwork goes on treating it as a project without version control until you switch it in its Version Control tab.
service.workspace.platformInvalid: {project}'s project.json names a version control Combwork doesn't know (platform: {value}). Until it says "git" or "none", Combwork uses what it finds in the folder.
service.workspace.platformJjFound: {project} is a jj repository. Combwork goes on with its version control as it is until you switch it to jj in its Version Control tab.
service.workspace.platformJjGone: {project}'s jj repository is gone. Switch it to Git or None in its Version Control tab.
service.workspace.platformOtherFound: {vcs} was found in {project}. Combwork doesn't support it yet, and goes on treating the project as a Git project until you switch it to None in its Version Control tab.
service.workspace.platformRepositoryGone: {project}'s Git repository is gone. Git's rules hold, so its cards can't move on until the repository is back or you switch the project to None in its Version Control tab.
service.workspace.sharedNames: Agent names are unique across the workspace now, so each agent can be told apart. {shared}: they keep working, but rename one of each, e.g. {project}'s {agent} to {suggestion}.
service.workspace.stillClosing: {name} is still closing: wait for it to finish, then try again.
service.workspace.stillOpening: {name} is still opening: wait for it to finish, then try again.
